items.source: With HttpServletResponse.sendError, the response is considered complete and should not be written to any further. Furthermore, the Servlet container will typically write an HTML error page therefore making the use of a reason unsuitable for REST APIs. For such cases it is preferable to use a ResponseEntity as a return type and avoid the use of @ResponseStatus altogether.
items.translation: 使用 `HttpServletResponse.sendError` 时，响应被视为已完成，不应再写入任何内容。此外，Servlet 容器通常会生成 HTML 错误页面，因此使用 `reason` 对于 REST API 并不合适。在这种情况下，最好将 `ResponseEntity` 用作返回类型，并完全避免使用 `@ResponseStatus`。

items.source: Note that a controller class may also be annotated with @ResponseStatus which is then inherited by all @RequestMapping and @ExceptionHandler methods in that class and its subclasses unless overridden by a local @ResponseStatus declaration on the method.
items.translation: 注意，控制器类也可以标注`@ResponseStatus`，该注解会被该类及其子类中所有`@RequestMapping`和`@ExceptionHandler`方法继承，除非该方法上存在本地`@ResponseStatus`声明进行覆盖。

items.source: Warning: when using this annotation on an exception class, or when setting the reason attribute of this annotation, the HttpServletResponse.sendError method will be used.
items.translation: 警告：当在异常类上使用此注解，或设置此注解的reason属性时，将使用HttpServletResponse.sendError方法。

items.source: The status code is applied to the HTTP response when the handler method is invoked, but does not override status information set by other means, such as ResponseEntity or "redirect:".
items.translation: 状态码在调用处理器方法时应用于 HTTP 响应，但不会覆盖通过其他方式（如 `ResponseEntity` 或 `"redirect:"`）设置的状态信息。

items.source: Default is HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, which should typically be changed to something more appropriate.
items.translation: 默认值为HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR，通常应将其更改为更合适的值。

items.source:
Defaults to an empty string which will be ignored. Set the reason to a
non-empty value to have it used to send a Servlet container error page.
In this case, the return value of the handler method will be ignored.
items.translation: 默认为空字符串，将被忽略。将原因设置为非空值以用于发送 Servlet 容器错误页面。在这种情况下，处理程序方法的返回值将被忽略。

items.source: The status code to use for the response.
The reason to be used for the response.
